subject: MedAlign DPA execution & audit evidence (SOC 2, pen test)
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medalign.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medalign.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: MedAlign DPA redlines for review

Hi Marissa,

Attached is our draft with redlines to Redwood's standard DPA (see MedAlign_DPA_Redlines_20270501.docx). A few highlights for your team to review: 

- Audit rights: we retained a broad right to request documentation and on-site access (Section 7). Please confirm your process for scheduling auditor access and how often you expect these requests.
- Subprocessors: we listed the vendors we must ensure are contractually bound (see Appendix A) and asked for written confirmation that Redwood will notify us 30 days prior to adding any new subprocessor with cross-border access.
- Data transfer: we included standard SCC references and asked Redwood to confirm your transfer mechanism for EU/UK data.
- Evidence: we requested a copy of your current SOC 2 report and a high-level pen test summary; we need these to complete our legal sign-off.

If possible, could we get an initial response by EOD Monday? If it helps, I'm happy to set a short call with procurement/legal.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Compliance
MedAlign Health
Attachments: MedAlign_DPA_Redlines_20270501.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign DPA redlines for review

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary. We appreciate the diligence. Quick notes from product/legal ops: 

- We can support a scoped audit process. To align expectations: Redwood typically requests (a) a single annual external audit or (b) a mutually agreed on-site visit with at least 30 days' notice. Could you confirm whether MedAlign expects recurring ad-hoc audits or a planned annual cadence?
- Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a live registry and provides 30-day notice for new subprocessors. I'll loop in Vivek to share the current list and any upcoming changes.
- Data transfers: we rely on SCCs for EU/UK transfers and can execute DPA language referencing SCCs or alternative transfer mechanisms if preferred.
- Evidence: we can share our latest SOC 2 summary and a pen test overview under an NDA or via a secure link.

Would you (or legal) be available for a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the audit language and execution steps? If so, I can send a calendar invite. If you're ready to proceed, we can also prepare the DocuSign packet once we lock language on the audit clause.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0172

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medalign.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign DPA redlines for review

Sarah / Marissa — quick legal read and suggested path forward. Inline summary below.

> Audit rights: we retained a broad right to request documentation and on-site access (Section 7). Please confirm your process for scheduling auditor access and how often you expect these requests.

We are open to providing reasonable audit rights, but we need to narrow the language so it is operationally feasible. Suggested edits we will propose: 
- Replace "unlimited on-site access" with "reasonably scoped audit access, subject to mutually agreed dates and confidentiality protections."
- Define audit window: MedAlign may request up to 2 audits in a 12-month period, each limited to systems processing MedAlign data, with at least 30 days' notice (or alternative remote review).

> Subprocessors: we listed the vendors we must ensure are contractually bound (see Appendix A) and asked for written confirmation that Redwood will notify us 30 days prior to adding any new subprocessor with cross-border access.

We can agree to a 30-day notice for subprocessors. Please confirm whether MedAlign expects pre-approval for specific classes of subprocessors (e.g., analytics, security monitoring). If so, we will need to carve that scope into the DPA.

> Data transfer: we included standard SCC references and asked Redwood to confirm your transfer mechanism for EU/UK data.

Confirmed: Redwood uses SCCs and supplementary contractual measures. We'll include this as a defined mechanism in the DPA.

Operational asks:
- Vivek, can you attach the current subprocessors registry and call out any upcoming changes?
- Laura, once language is final, can you run the DocuSign packet and finance checklist (billing/PO) if required?

Happy to take the redline and propose a clean DPA ready for e-signature.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medalign.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medalign.com
Date: 2027-05-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign DPA redlines for review

Thanks, Karthik — that's helpful. We discussed internally and can accept the concept of a "reasonably scoped audit" provided the DPA explicitly: (1) allows up to two audits per year, (2) permits either a third-party auditor engaged by MedAlign or MedAlign's internal audit team, and (3) requires Redwood to provide remediation evidence for critical findings within 45 days.

I've attached the requested evidence: MedAlign_SOC2_summary_20270420.pdf and MedAlign_pen_test_20270315.zip. We can do an NDA-level secure transfer for any additional artifacts.

Next steps from our side:
- If Redwood can post proposed edits reflecting the "reasonably scoped audit" language, we will review and accept if aligned.
- We'll route the final DPA through DocuSign. Signing parties: Sarah Jenkins (Compliance) and Tom Hargreaves (Procurement).
- Procurement will require a signed DPA + PO or vendor profile in our system. We can accept DocuSign for the DPA and separate PO routing.

DocuSign link (for reference once ready): https://app.docusign.com/links/ABCDEFG12345

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Compliance
MedAlign Health
Attachments: MedAlign_SOC2_summary_20270420.pdf; MedAlign_pen_test_20270315.zip

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedAlign DPA redlines for review

Thanks, Sarah — received the SOC2 summary and pen test bundle. Appreciate the flexibility on audit scope. Quick recap and next actions from Redwood: 

- Karthik will draft the limited-audit clause tonight reflecting: up to two audits/year, mutually agreed dates, third-party or internal auditor allowed, and a 45-day remediation evidence timeline for critical findings. 
- Vivek will attach the current subprocessors registry and flag any upcoming changes (we'll give MedAlign 30 days' notice for new subprocessors that access EU/UK data).
- Laura will prepare the DocuSign packet and finance checklist (HubSpot: HS-4521) and confirm whether we require a PO before completing signature for procurement.

I will prepare the clean DPA draft and route it to you via DocuSign once legal signs off. Tentative timeline: draft sent by 2027-05-05 EOD; target execution by 2027-05-12 if there are no substantive issues.

Quoted for context:
> "We can agree to a 30-day notice for subprocessors." — Marissa Cole

Please let me know if MedAlign needs any further evidence in the packet (full SOC2 report vs summary, detailed remediation plans). If you want us to host the full SOC2 under an NDA, we can provide a secure link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: None
